sources.title: OVHcloud US: HIL VPS host incident resolved November 10, 2026
sources.summary: The original operator report identifies an actual issue affecting a VPS host at location HIL, records remediation and marks the incident resolved at 20:33 UTC on November 10. This evidences existing commercial hosting at Hillsboro. The statement that some VPS instances may be unavailable is conditional; no claim is made that every instance or the whole facility lost service.

extraction.time_zone_basis: The original rendered timestamps explicitly say UTC.
extraction.physical_scope: Actual VPS host issue and remediation, followed by resolution; conditional impact to some virtual instances is preserved. No exact rack identifier is supplied for this event.
extraction.supporting_earlier_event: Original October 19 incident expressly names the Hillsboro Data Center and rack H111A08, reports a vRack fault and then no further impact at 20:46 UTC. This provides a separate physical-host corroboration, not the selected newer observation date.
extraction.successor_review: The captured original US status history and HIL-filtered history were read through November 11. A later November 10 VPS host incident identifies location HIL, records actual remediation and resolves the incident at 20:33 UTC; it supersedes the first October 19 rack-fault lead as the current observation. Completed infrastructure-maintenance updates through November 10 corroborate continued work inside the existing site but do not commission a new expansion. Future November 12 and later scheduled maintenance are not completed observations. This is a bounded public status-history review, not an exhaustive corporate archive or claim of uninterrupted service.

OVH/OVHcloud, HIL1/HIL-1, 1300 NE 25th Avenue, Data Center West Coast, H111A08 and HIL0115 aliases were checked.
